answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 23 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in glacier, verified in jetty, and opal names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 452 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
